name: OUTPUT_WINDOW_SETTINGS
description: Output window appearance for *_with_output_window modes. FRACT_/ABSOLUTE_ position keys apply when WINDOW_POSITION=absolute. Since OMC 5.6 the window is a built-in ActionUI document; transparency, fades and custom PNG windows are gone.

LINE_OUTPUT_INTERVAL.note: no longer read by the engine

CUSTOM_WINDOW_PNG_IMAGE.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_TEXTBOX_POSITION_TOP.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_TEXTBOX_POSITION_LEFT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_TEXTBOX_WIDTH.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_TEXTBOX_HEIGHT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_CLOSEBOX_POSITION_TOP.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_CLOSEBOX_POSITION_LEFT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_CLOSEBOX_WIDTH.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_CLOSEBOX_HEIGHT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_RESIZEBOX_POSITION_BOTTOM.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_RESIZEBOX_POSITION_RIGHT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_RESIZEBOX_WIDTH.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

CUSTOM_RESIZEBOX_HEIGHT.note: custom PNG windows are gone since OMC 5.6

WINDOW_TYPE.description: Defaults to floating (global_floating in a process that is not a regular app).

TEXT_FONT.description: Font name; defaults to Monaco. Where the font is missing, the monospaced system font.

TEXT_COLOR.description: RRGGBB, with or without #; defaults to the system's text color (light or dark).

BACKGROUND_COLOR.description: RRGGBB, with or without #; defaults to the system's text background (light or dark).

AUTO_CLOSE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds after the command ends; without it the window stays open; 0 closes it at once.

AUTO_CLOSE_ON_SUCCESS_ONLY.description: Defaults to true: a command that failed keeps its window open.
